title: Weighted approximate tangent space from an unweighted one on a piece with continuous weight (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1))
statement: Let M, C ⊆ ℝ^Q be Hⁿ-null-measurable with C ⊆ M, y ∈ C, θ : ℝ^Q → ℝ with θ ≥ 0 on M, and T a linear subspace of ℝ^Q. Assume: T is the (unweighted, Def. 1.4) approximate tangent space of C at y; there is r > 0 with Hⁿ(C ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ and θ Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_r(y); θ|C is continuous at y (ContinuousWithinAt θ C y); and (∫⁻_{(M∖C) ∩ B̄_ρ(y)} ofReal(θ) dHⁿ)/ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0+. Then HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (M C : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → C ⊆ M → y ∈ C → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ x) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞ ∧ IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → ContinuousWithinAt θ C y → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in (M \ C) ∩ closedBall y ρ, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T
